summary: Vale S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Board of Directors resolved to remove Board member Marcelo Gasparino da Silva due to leakage of confidential information from a June 19, 2026 board meeting. The removal was based on an independent investigation by an external law firm, following recommendations from the Audit and Risk Committee. Since he is a board member, the sanction must be approved at an Extraordinary General Shareholders Meeting. No financial terms, deal structure, or strategic transaction are involved; the filing solely concerns an abrupt board departure due to misconduct.
